# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mobile-first portrait browser game titled **Hylith Grove: Trial of the Verdant Gate**. Preserve the source mechanics: top-down free-roam joystick movement, acceleration/friction, speed cap, large scrolling world, rotated gate collision that launches the hero when fast enough, airborne state with gravity, one action-button trick while airborne, clean landing that awards combo x 100 score, thorn hazards that bounce rather than kill, manual Seal end state, and restart overlay.

Transform the presentation into a Zelda-like mythic overworld shrine adventure. The player is a compact green-clad shield-hero. Gates are golden sigil bridges. Action buttons are item runes labeled BOMB, HOOK, and ORB. Score is recovered LIGHT. Hazards are curse brambles. Use procedural Canvas/CSS motifs: living canopy drift, shrine fog, rune grid, triangular grove glyphs, shield aura, golden particles, and fantasy panel HUD. Optimize readability and touch targets for portrait viewports in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: mobile-first top-down free-roam traversal / trick-score arcade adventure.
- objective: guide the avatar across a large overworld, build speed, cross glowing gates to become airborne, press an action while airborne, and land after the trick window expires to bank score.
- input model: pointer-driven virtual joystick on the left, three action buttons on the right, a seal/end button, and restart button on game-over overlay.
- core loop: move on ground, accelerate with joystick, collide with gate at speed to enter air state, trigger one trick action, land cleanly to add combo x 100 score, avoid or rebound from thorn hazards, repeat until the player seals the quest.
- fail/friction state: there is no life-loss fail state; thorns bounce the avatar into air with shake/particles, and landing while trickTimer remains active fumbles the rune and cancels combo. Manual Seal ends the run and opens the restart modal.

## Protected Mechanics
- Joystick acceleration, friction, speed cap, world clamping, camera follow, and portrait touch controls are protected.
- Gate hit detection uses rotated rectangle bounds and only launches when ground speed exceeds 100.
- Air state keeps velocity, applies vertical gravity, allows action-button trick only while airborne, and banks score only on clean landing after trickTimer expires.
- Thorn hazards remain non-terminal bump hazards that launch the avatar and cause feedback rather than changing scoring semantics.
- End/restart overlay flow and audio-unlock-on-user-gesture behavior are preserved.

## Remix Trajectory
The source is reinterpreted as a Zelda-like mythic overworld trial: the avatar is a green-clad shield-hero, gates are ancient sigil bridges, action buttons are item-runes (BOMB, HOOK, ORB), score is recovered relic light, thorns are curse brambles, and the manual end state is sealing the Verdant Gate. Presentation can transform aggressively through HUD wording, procedural fantasy scene layers, shrine/rune motifs, focal silhouette, and mobile UI chrome while retaining the protected loop.
